label: 开膝侧坐前倾
pose_lead: Grounded pose, side-sit with knees open and torso leaning forward:
lower_limbs: One leg folds in front of the body while the other tucks folded to the rear side, the two knees pointing different directions.
upper_limbs: Both arms reach forward and down, hands side by side on the ground.
torso_head: The upper body leans forward, the shoulders slightly drawn in, the head low and turned to one side.
weight_silhouette: The figure composes a wide triangle: upper body pitching forward, legs opening to both sides.
